issues: Pre-existing (iter19) React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Editor-injected data-ve-dynamic wrapper spans around dynamic option label text in Home.js lines 158/162. Dev-only warning, does not affect functionality. Not caused by this iteration's changes.

critical_code_review_comments: conftest.py load_dotenv path resolves relative to file location — good; but tests must be invoked from /app/backend (pytest rootdir) for `from tests.conftest import ...` to resolve. Running pytest from /app fails with ModuleNotFoundError. Recommend adding a top-level /app/conftest.py or documenting the required cwd in a README / adding pytest.ini with rootdir=/app/backend to prevent CI breakage.

PracticeQuestions.js lines 157/165 still have empty-body catches (`} catch { toast.error(...) }`) — although a toast is shown, the error object itself is silently discarded. Consider `catch (err) { console.error('bookmark failed:', err); toast.error(...) }` for consistency with the other patched sites in the same file.

TopicEditor.js lines 146, 170, 381, 414 still have catch blocks whose bodies were not shown in the requested fix — verify none of these are silent-swallow patterns. Only line 157 was patched per the request.

videos_api.py list_folders refactor (lines 216-225) is clean, but the sort key lambda relies on `x['name']` — if any legacy doc has folder=None, distinct() will include None and sort will TypeError. Consider filtering out None with `folders = [f for f in folders if f]`.
